kind: Actual final documentation-only build and guide surface observation

desktop.heading: Verification scope and submission gates
desktop.verificationText: Offcut 1.1.0 passed 884 source-contract tests and 72 executed browser cases: 18 contracts on each local/hosted and Chrome-149/152 combination. The actual public-app demonstration contains 19 model-selected native calls, with separate automated UI actions. Source identity, measured optimization workloads, native profiles and all 12 actually rendered maximum-cut PDF pages are recorded in the portable verification report. Final encoded-video duration, audio, captions and visual checks have their own media verification record; neither report is an account-publication or winning claim.

imageInspection.scope: Actual desktop/mobile Chrome screenshots inspected; vertical screenshot edges are viewport boundaries, not horizontal content defects

scope: Only guide text changes in final static deployment. App JS/CSS bytes exactly match the actually tested/recorded candidate; no invented retest of code after doc-only change.
